module inventory.reorder
  purpose: Report the products whose stock has fallen below their reorder level.

import std.console
import std.environment
import std.filesystem
import std.filesystem exposing Path
import std.json

public type AppError is one of
  purpose: The ways the reorder report can fail.
  MissingPath
  Unreadable(detail: Text)
  BadJson
end

public type Product
  purpose: A stocked product with its current stock and reorder threshold.
  has name: Text
  has stock: Integer where stock is at least 0
  has reorder_level: Integer where reorder_level is at least 0
  can FromJson
end

public function low_stock(products: List of Product)
  returns List of Product
  purpose: Keep the products below their reorder level, lowest stock first.
  tags: inventory
  example: low_stock([]) is []

  return for each product in products
    where product.stock is less than product.reorder_level
    sorted by product.stock
    collect product
end

public function describe_product(product: Product)
  returns Text
  purpose: Format one product as a report line.
  tags: inventory
  example: describe_product(Product(name: "Bolt", stock: 2, reorder_level: 10)) is "Bolt: stock 2, reorder level 10"

  return "{product.name}: stock {product.stock}, reorder level {product.reorder_level}"
end

public function main() or fails with AppError
  needs console, environment, filesystem.read
  purpose: Read the product file named by the first argument and print the products to reorder.

  let arguments be environment.arguments()
  let path_text be arguments.first() otherwise fail with MissingPath
  let path be Path(path_text)
  let text be filesystem.read_text(path) otherwise fail with Unreadable(detail: "cannot read {path_text}")
  let products: List of Product be json.parse(text) otherwise fail with BadJson
  for each product in low_stock(products)
    console.print(describe_product(product))
  end
end
